title.zh: 从国会救济基金拨款14,700菲律宾比索，用于完成伊洛科斯苏尔省与阿布拉省维甘—班格德公路的建设和维修的法案
title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF FOURTEEN THOUSAND SEVEN HUNDRED PESOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, FROM THE CONGRESSIONAL RELIEF FUND, TO COMPLETE THE CONSTRUCTION AND REPAIR OF THE VIGAN-BANGUED ROAD IN THE PROVINCES OF ILOCOS SUR AND ABRA.
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF FOURTEEN THOUSAND SEVEN HUNDRED PESOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, FROM THE CONGRESSIONAL RELIEF FUND, TO COMPLETE THE CONSTRUCTION AND REPAIR OF THE VIGAN-BANGUED ROAD IN THE PROVINCES OF ILOCOS SUR AND ABRA.
title.vi: Luật cấp 14.700 peso Philippines từ Quỹ Cứu trợ Quốc hội để hoàn thành xây dựng và sửa chữa đường Vigan–Bangued tại các tỉnh Ilocos Sur và Abra
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรเงิน 14,700 เปโซฟิลิปปินส์จากกองทุนบรรเทาทุกข์ของรัฐสภา เพื่อก่อสร้างและซ่อมแซมถนน Vigan–Bangued ในจังหวัด Ilocos Sur และ Abra ให้แล้วเสร็จ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengalokasikan 14.700 peso Filipina dari Dana Bantuan Kongres untuk menyelesaikan pembangunan dan perbaikan jalan Vigan–Bangued di Provinsi Ilocos Sur dan Abra
title.ms: Akta memperuntukkan 14,700 peso Filipina daripada Dana Bantuan Kongres untuk menyiapkan pembinaan dan pembaikan jalan Vigan–Bangued di wilayah Ilocos Sur dan Abra

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of the Congressional relief fund, the sum of fourteen thousand
seven hundred pesos. Philippine currency, or so much thereof as may be necessary, for the purpose of
completing the work of construction and repair, including the necessary bridges, on the Vigan-Bangued road.
Provinces of Ilocos Sur and Abra, previous appropriation for which has been made by Act Numbered Nine
hundred and twenty. The provisions and conditions provided in sections two to six, inclusive, of said Act
Numbered Nine hundred, and twenty are hereby made applicable to the expenditure of this appropriation.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order or procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, July 15, 1904.
